defs.def: to stop sleeping; to make sb stop sleeping 醒；醒来；唤醒；弄醒

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: Keep your sleep/wake schedule on weekends.
ex.t: 保持周末的睡眠/唤醒作息。

ex.s: You go to bed in one kind of world and wake up to find yourself in another quite different,and if this is not magic, then where is it to be found?
ex.t: 你入睡时身处一个世界，醒来却发现自己身处另一个截然不同的世界——如果这都不是魔法，那魔法又在哪里呢？

ex.s: We eat, drink, wake up, breathe and live with you!
ex.t: 我们和你一起吃饭、喝水、醒来、呼吸、生活！

ex.s: In the morning, I wake up and immediately check my messages.
ex.t: 早上，我一醒来就立刻查看消息。

ex.s: I wake up to the sound of the wind buffeting the cloth of my tent.
ex.t: 我在风拍打帐篷布的声音中醒来。

ex.s: For unless we do listen to Rachel Carson’s warning, one day we may wake up to the strange and quiet horror of another silent spring.
ex.t: 因为除非我们确实倾听了蕾切尔·卡森的警告，否则有一天我们可能会醒来，面对另一个寂静春天的奇异而寂静的恐怖。

defs.def: to make sb remember sth or feel sth again 唤起（记忆）；使再次感觉到
an occasion before or after a funeral when people gather to remember the dead person, traditionally held the night before the funeral to watch over the body before it is buried （葬礼前的）守夜；守灵
the track that a boat or ship leaves behind on the surface of the water （船只航行时的）尾流，航迹

ex.s: Now that you know why you want to wake up, consider re-arranging your morning activities.
ex.t: 现在你已经知道为什么要早起了，考虑重新安排你的早晨活动吧。
